subject: Vendor finance setup: ACH or wire, invoicing pathways & PO routing
messages:

Date: 2027-03-08T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: New vendor — getting set up for payments

Hi Aditya,

Thanks for the onboarding checklist you mentioned during the demo. We're ready to get Oramarkets set up as a Redwood vendor so we can start receiving POs and submit invoices. A couple quick items to confirm on our side:

- Preferred payment method: ACH is preferred for faster settlement, but we can accept wire if required.
- Remittance emails: would you like remits sent to procurement@oramarkets.com or a dedicated remittance address?
- Invoice submission: we currently upload to our AP SFTP (sftp://sftp.oramarkets.com/incoming) or can email invoices from procurement@oramarkets.com.
- Tax form: happy to provide W-9 or VAT form depending on requirements.

Can you send the vendor form and any bank details template Redwood needs so our finance team can populate it and return? We're targeting to close setup before month-end so the first invoice can be paid in the next cycle.

Thanks,
Sarah Lim

Oramarkets Inc.
procurement@oramarkets.com

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>

Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-08T10:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor — getting set up for payments

Hi Sarah — great to kick this off. Attaching the standard vendor onboarding form and our ACH template to make it easy for your AP team. A few notes / asks from Redwood finance to avoid delays: 

- Payment methods: ACH preferred for US vendors (faster, lower fees). Wires are accepted for international banks or if ACH routing isn't available, but they incur a $25 wire fee.
- Remittance: please designate a single remittance email (preferred) or the SFTP path you referenced. Redwood posts remittance advices to the remittance email on payment date; we do not push remits to third-party portals.
- Invoice submission: Redwood requires one of the following — (1) upload invoice PDF to our vendor portal (link below), (2) SFTP drop to sftp.redwood.com/vendor-inbound (we can provision a user for you), or (3) invoices@redwood.com (only for vendors who can't use SFTP or portal). Please do not send invoices to individual employee mailboxes.
- PO matching: every invoice must include the Redwood PO number in the invoice header or as a line item; otherwise it will be held for manual matching and delayed.
- Tax form: please attach a completed W-9 (US vendors) or equivalent VAT documentation. I attached a short W-9 request doc.
- Payment terms: default Net30 from invoice receipt; if your team needs Net45/Net60 we can discuss but that requires commercial approval (slower).

Attachments: vendor_onboarding_form.xlsx, redwood_ach_template.csv, w9_request.pdf
Links: Vendor portal: https://vendor.redwood.com (request access after you return the form)
DocuSign for bank authorization (optional): https://app.docusign.com/doc/ABC123XYZ
HubSpot record: hubspot://deal/HS-99823

If you can return the form and ACH template by Thursday EOD, Monica (cc'd) will take it from there and confirm account provisioning on our side. I'll also create the PO to link to your first invoice once the vendor record is created.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>

Hi Sarah — thanks for the quick turnaround and for attaching the forms. A couple items from Finance so the first invoice clears without a hold: 

1) We've reviewed the ACH template and the account details look complete. I will send a short DocuSign consent form (link below) we use to verify account ownership; please have your AP sign that so Treasury can finalize the routing.
2) SFTP provisioning: we can create a vendor SFTP account on sftp.redwood.com and will email credentials to your designated technical contact. Please confirm the username you'd like provisioned (or we can auto-generate). Typical retention window for incoming invoices is 90 days; we recommend also sending a copy to invoices@redwood.com for redundancy during the first month.
3) PO matching: we require PO number on the invoice header. Our AR system will auto-pay only when PO and vendor match succeed; exceptions will move the invoice to manual review (adds 7–10 business days).
4) Payment terms & schedule: Net30 from invoice receipt. Redwood runs vendor payments on the 15th and last business day of each month; after payment posts we'll send remittance advice to remits@oramarkets.com.

DocuSign for bank authorization: https://app.docusign.com/doc/ABC123XYZ
SFTP provisioning link (internal): sftp://sftp.redwood.com/vendor-inbound
HubSpot ticket: hubspot://deal/HS-99823

Next steps (summary):
- Monica to send DocuSign bank-auth request (today).
- Redwood IT to provision SFTP user (once we get required contact/email).
- Aditya to create initial PO once vendor record is live.

I'll follow up when the SFTP credentials are ready — should be 1–2 business days after signed DocuSign. If you'd prefer wire instead of ACH, flag it and we'll note the wire fee and routing requirements.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Finance Operations | Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com
